name: athlevo
description: Athlevo web application and Capacitor iOS/Android shells

scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:prepare && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:prepare && cap run android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run build:native && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:prepare && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:prepare && cap run ios
